figures.title: Architecture
figures.caption: r2 net 357: layer sizes read from the saved weights (43,555 numbers). Two heads share the trunk.

figures.title: Weights per layer
figures.caption: A wide, centred histogram means the layer is used. A spike at 0 would mean dead units; the policy head is wider because its logits must be sharp (the net agrees with the search's buy ~98% of the time).

figures.title: What it wants to buy
figures.caption: The net's probabilities over the legal buys in six situations from the Play tab's games (net seat, no search). Look for: Gold over Province early, Province at $8 later, Duchy when the game is ending.

figures.title: What it looks at
figures.caption: How much the buy probabilities move (total variation, averaged over all recorded buy decisions) when one input is nudged by one standard deviation. The 25 most influential of the 175 inputs.
